prose: TIME interviewed President Trump at the White House on Sept. 28, covering Iran, the AI boom, the Fed, the Supreme Court and the midterms. Per the Techmeme blurb he said Dario Amodei's views differ much from what is portrayed in the media, and discussed meetings with AI leaders and 'Super Intelligence'. Based on the opening of the transcript and the blurb.
highlights: Trump on Amodei: views differ from media portrayal
